request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. 69 BPM E minor passacaglia. Eight-bar pipe-organ ground bass feels like unstoppable roots. Above it, successive variations of interrupted bowed strings, bowed glass, col legno and snap pizzicato. Second half adds solemn wordless choir and a fragile distant wordless female hum resisting above it; plucked Crimson Thread countertheme. Sacred pressure, a living greenhouse cathedral, no lyrics or language. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
